title: Baidu Robotaxi Allegedly Involved in Collision with Pedestrian in Wuhan

behaviors.text: On July 7, 2024, a Baidu Robotaxi reportedly collided with a [person] at a traffic intersection in Wuhan.
The incident occurred as the autonomous vehicle started moving on a green light while the [person] was allegedly crossing against a red light.
The [person] sustained minor injuries, and Baidu was reported to have been cooperating with local authorities for further investigation.
